newsitem.title: USA: Banc One granted more underwriting powers.
newsitem.headline: Banc One granted more underwriting powers.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Monday said it approved a proposal by Banc One Corp to allow the company, through a subsidiary, to engage in underwriting and dealing in most types of debt and equity securities.
The only restriction will be that Banc One cannot deal in ownership interests in open-end investment companies.
Banc One is the 10th-largest bank in the United States with assets of $98.6 billion.
Banc One, based in Columbus, Ohio, currently has the power to conduct limited underwriting and dealing in some types of securities, as permitted under section 20 of the Glass-Steagall Act.
The company will continue to be a broker-dealer registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and a member of the National Association of Securities Dealers Inc.
